answer: Sybil resistance here rests on proof-of-holding rather than identity: each agent address must lock a real, slashable balance before its attestations count toward any quorum, and weight scales with stake, not headcount. A thousand fresh addresses buy nothing, since unstaked clones carry zero weight and are ignored. To shift a tally, an attacker must fund every clone with collateral, so the cost of a Sybil farm grows linearly with any influence gained, and misbehaviour forfeits all of it. The economic cipher is plain: no cheap fable of many identities, only a pulse of real capital at risk.
